listing.name: Army of Two: The Devil's Cartel / Ueberkill---Army-of-Two-The-Devil-s-Cartel-PC-Port
listing.summary: Another Vibecoded PC Port of Army of Two: The Devil's Cartel, with some ideas that hopefully make the game a bit better as a solo player, giving you the option to play as Bravo and Customizing your Partner. Still not perfect, but I am trying. Demo and DLC Goodies are already included on the disk, no need for DLC files.
